## Frozen acceptance scope — owner decision 2026-10-31

**Required to close PR #188:** deliver exactly nine verified real-audio MP4 approval videos covering the canonical six-member snowman band (original drummer; no xylophonist), the original 256-channel AC layout, and the required advanced RGB layouts, including singing faces where specified. Confirm independent lead/harmony vocals, musically meaningful sections/phrases, synchronized real audio, and native xLights XSQ/FSEQ compatibility. Resolve release-blocking CI failures only.

**Not a blocker:** the proposed twelve-panel comparison MP4; track separately if desired. No new feature scope, broad rewrite, or speculative optimization may delay this PR.

**Approval gate:** owner must visually approve the nine MP4s before merge or beta release. Do not interpret approval of this scope as approval to merge. Keep issue #199 open until its release criteria are independently satisfied.

**Current status:** approval videos and full native verification are not yet confirmed complete; CI outcomes must be verified against the latest run. Do not relabel diagnostics as accepted videos.

pr205.body:
The master run repeats expensive audio feature work across separate runs. This PR adds a typed lazy facade for the existing CLI/GUI and native sampler callers, extracts shared audio features and canonical percussion assembly, and offers opt-in content/version/code-bound NPZ reuse through `HELIX_AUDIO_CACHE_DIR`. `HELIX_PROFILE_OUTPUT` records inclusive stage timings and process peak RSS. It also fixes tied-score preview selection and adds real frozen-worker/native verification.

**Decision: HOLD release-path signoff.** The feature branch incorporates recovery `05c1de5` and is conflict-free. Output preservation and Windows frozen caching are verified, but hosted numerical portability and native visual acceptance still fail. PR188 remains unmerged; beta publication and owner acceptance remain held.

### Completed proof

- Exact original **237.44-second MP3**, SHA256 `8ced92ba...`: recovery control and candidate cache-off/miss/hit all produce **42,305 effects**, historical XSQ SHA256 `258f03ef...` and identical band SHA256 `0d1c9c21...`. Declared-target and bounded-time contracts pass. Additional 237.44-second PCM and 34.88-second real MP3 comparisons also retain exact outputs.
- **68-event/eight-target drummer oracle:** ordered cue/motion/debug payloads match byte-for-byte; zero event/time/target drift. Protected detector, mapper, motion, geometry, original AC wiring/colors and thresholds are unchanged.
- **Windows packaged execution succeeds**, including cache-off/miss/hit equality of XSQ/band hashes and unchanged NPZ bytes/mtime on the hit. Existing packaged GUI, FSEQ and LOR checks pass. [Windows run](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/actions/runs/41874095171); authenticated diagnostic artifact13345378551 was downloaded and verified.
- Local `tests/` suites on Python3.11/3.12 each pass 2,349 tests plus24 subtests with six existing skips; three additional root-collected preview tests pass per runtime. These local results do not override the hosted failures below.
- Preview winner selection now ranks numeric fields without comparing dictionaries; existing priorities and source-order ties are preserved. Seven local cases pass and [the actual preview workflow succeeds](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/actions/runs/41874083876).
- Three real native shows—AC256, canonical dimensional band and RGB singing faces—successfully export FSEQ and 1920×1080 H.264/AAC at20fps. Each698-frame movie fully decodes, soundtrack correlation is0.9968248 and all four alignment windows show0ms lag. Recovery/candidate source plans and all three derived XSQs are byte-identical to the actual CI-rendered inputs.

### Failed gates that remain open

1. **Hosted Python3.11/3.12 both fail four bounded-chroma cases** at unchanged `atol=1e-7, rtol=0`; maximum entropy difference2.66020723e-7. Each hosted push job has2,348 passing tests,24 passing subtests and six skips. [Push CI](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/actions/runs/41874083597) and [PR CI](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/actions/runs/41874095074) both fail. Selecting Haswell/Zen BLAS kernels reproduces four failures locally; default SkylakeX/Sandybridge passes. Recovery control also fails four cases under Haswell, and the bounded function AST is identical. No CPU pin, tolerance relaxation or speculative DSP rewrite was applied.
2. **Native visual gates fail on all three movies**: AC luminance9.466<12; band luminance8.963<12 and motion0.625<0.65; face bright fraction0.01110<0.012. [Native regression run](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/actions/runs/41874095353). Export/decode/audio success is not visual approval. Failed media remains diagnostic.
3. Independent singer/acoustic/lexical qualification, physical qualification and the owner's nine-video approval scope remain separate beta gates.

[Verification report and minimum next checks](https://github.com/ryankorkowski-boop/helix-sequencer/blob/9f247bf54c5322dc888a43b8f30d205b55075de0/docs/PR205_VERIFICATION_20261104.md). Source-bound receipts, original-input reproduction scripts and backend failure evidence are under `evidence/beta_completion/pr205_verification_20261104/`. MASTER_TODO.md, live handoff, status and artifact inventory are updated.

Verified implementation: `37fb716`; subsequent `9f247bf` is an evidence-only receipt with identical implementation module hashes and skips redundant CI. Original MP3 CLI measurements are218.75s cold control,191.86s cache-off,184.27s miss and151.20s hit; the first control includes initial stem computation, so no controlled overall speedup is claimed. No merge, release approval or broad universal-intelligence integration is included.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retain explicit note ends when building keyboard cues**

For detected notes shorter than 120 ms, `_event_end_ms` treats `fallback_ms` as a minimum duration even when an explicit `end_ms` exists, so this changes the source note timing before native pitched-prop export. Two same-pitch notes at 100–140 ms and 180–220 ms become 100–220 ms and 180–300 ms; `schedule_keyboard_rungs` then merges them into one continuous 100–300 ms activation, losing the intervening rest and repeated attack. The harmonic detector can emit notes as short as 40 ms, so use the explicit valid end time and reserve the fallback for missing timestamps.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Synchronize the format when users change sequencer mode**

If a user selects Light-O-Rama in the visible Sequencer Mode selector while Sequence output retains its default XSQ value, the UI enables the LMS input and disables the xLights inputs, but clicking Run silently switches back to xLights here. The reverse also occurs after selecting LMS/Both and then choosing xLights mode. The mode selector's callback only updates widget states, so these contradictory selections are reachable through ordinary interaction and can run the wrong pipeline or reject valid inputs. Synchronize both selectors when either changes, rather than overriding the user's mode selection at launch.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Respect submodel effects before adding whole-model accents**

When `--helix-spatial-accent` is enabled for an addressable pitched-prop layout, `run_profile` runs this pass after `apply_native_pitched_props`, which deliberately removes broad effects and writes note-specific `SubModelEffectLayer` effects. This overlap check examines only `EffectLayer`, so it considers the playing instrument empty and adds a whole-model On effect over its notes. Reproducing the two passes with `HX_CENTER_KEYBOARD_HELIX` playing MIDI 60 at a chorus adds a whole-keyboard flash from 1000–1170 ms, lighting every rung instead of only the selected key. Exclude note-owned props from broad accents or include their submodel activity in the overlap protection.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude explicit Off intervals from AC On pulses**

When an incoming AC model contains an explicit Off effect, this loop collects its interval without inspecting the effect name, and the exporter subsequently rewrites it as a full-intensity On pulse. For example, an On effect at 0–100 ms followed by Off at 100–1000 ms becomes one continuous 0–1000 ms On effect after interval merging, reversing the intended blackout. Filter explicit Off effects before collecting activation intervals so AC On-only conversion preserves unlit periods rather than energizing them.
